name: Shizu Call Recorder
tagline: Record phone calls on your phone without rooting it
description:
Shizu Call Recorder lets you record your phone calls even if your phone isn't rooted. It works by using Shizuku, a tool that safely gives apps extra permissions through ADB, so you get call recording without the risks of rooting.

It's built for people who need a simple, reliable way to keep a record of important calls, all handled locally on your device.
